candidate_findings.observation: The remote A-button fallback runs before TrySetupDiveDownScript, so a visible adjacent remote consumes A before the dive field action is evaluated.
candidate_findings.impact: On a valid dive-down tile, an adjacent remote can prevent the local player from diving, violating the requirement that every field action has precedence over remote interaction.
candidate_findings.recommendation: Move remote interaction fallback after every A-triggered local field action, including TrySetupDiveDownScript, while preserving CONSUMED_NO_LOCK semantics once all local actions decline; add an overlap regression for the dive-down path.
evidence: src/field_control_avatar.c:215-229 invokes CoopPresenceRuntime_TryInteract and immediately returns FIELD_INPUT_RESULT_CONSUMED_NO_LOCK for an eligible remote.
src/field_control_avatar.c:231-237 reaches TrySetupDiveDownScript only after the remote fallback has declined, although both paths are triggered by pressedAButton.
The sealed RPAC3-004 criterion requires every overlapping real object or field action to have precedence over a remote interaction.

candidate_findings.observation: The exact candidate leaves dist/bridge_manifest.json pinned to the predecessor ROM SHA even though the successfully built candidate ROM has a different digest.
candidate_findings.impact: The launcher validates the ROM against this manifest and will fail closed, so the reviewed ROM candidate cannot be launched through the intended cloud-coop path despite its source and focused tests passing.
candidate_findings.recommendation: Regenerate dist/bridge_manifest.json from the exact accepted ELF and ROM with an available ARM nm tool, include that generated path in the reviewed candidate, and re-run the manifest and launcher validation before integration.
evidence: The exact implementation worktree's successfully built pokeemerald.gba hashes to d9009861b8c7f89a3f2788bb0aa34a34e25beb4acedd166becd4771e0501e2fd.

rom-presence-activation-correction-v3-worker-terminal.candidate.json records both prescribed regeneration attempts as failures, yet marks RPAC3-006 satisfied and the review plan changed_paths omits dist/bridge_manifest.json.

candidate_findings.observation: The new runtime tests claim stale, warp, hidden-publication, capacity, and local-link coverage, but several named paths never reach the corresponding production state and local-link isolation is not exercised at all.
candidate_findings.impact: RPAC3-005 is not actually satisfied: regressions in stale renderer teardown and interaction denial, visible-to-hidden publication, warp teardown/recreation, capacity retry, or local-link behavior can pass the focused suite, weakening the evidence for the reviewed renderer and interaction changes.
candidate_findings.recommendation: Use the valid runtime fixture to create an active rendered remote before advancing 90 frames and before committing a warp; verify HIDDEN publication after a previously visible sample becomes unsafe; force actual ObjectEvent or sprite capacity failure and retry; and execute local-link collision and lookup behavior explicitly.
evidence: test/coop/presence_runtime.c:438-469 queues a spawn without a bound player, so CoopPresenceRuntime_Update cannot pass CoopPresenceRuntime_GetLocalState and never activates the reducer or renderer before the stale and warp assertions.

test/coop/presence_runtime.c:424-436 asserts only that no state can be produced without a player; it never first establishes a visible pose and then verifies an encoded COOP_PRESENCE_PLAYER_HIDDEN update.

test/coop/presence_runtime.c:471-661 exercises adoption, interpolation, return-to-field recreation, and queue-full interaction, but does not force initial ObjectEvent/sprite capacity failure or OnWarpCommit, and no Cloud Coop test references local-link state or link-player behavior.
